scoring_justification: Checker recomputes the fitting residual (RMSE) of the Vinet EOS using the agent's submitted parameters on the same pressure-volume data. Genuine fit must achieve low RMSE, preventing trivial parameter guesses.

hidden_assets.purpose: Pressure-volume data points for the high-pressure phase II of coronene (from Table 1) used to recompute RMSE of the Vinet EOS.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from Table 1 of Chanyshev et al., J. Struct. Chem. 2016. The four points (0.9, 2.1, 2.9, 4.0 GPa) correspond to the phase II measurements.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually transcribed from the paper's table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact experimental data that define the compressibility claim; using any other data would invalidate the reproduction.

outputs.description: Fitted zero‑pressure bulk modulus (K0 in GPa) and pressure derivative (K0′, dimensionless) from the Vinet equation of state applied to the provided pressure‑volume data.

output_contract.notes: The earlier experimental stages (2D XRD image integration, unit‑cell refinement) are omitted because raw diffraction images are not publicly available in machine‑readable form and require proprietary software. Only the final computational EOS fitting step with published table data is reproduced.
